focus_areas: Legibility and correctness of text on the dial (numbers and weather words).
Structural integrity of the pointer hand and its connection to the center hub.
Edge sharpness between the glass cover and the casing.
custom_prompts_for_reflector: Pay close attention to the text auditor's output. AI often fails at rendering small, curved text on dials. If the text is gibberish, increase artifact severity. Also, verify if the pointer hand casts a realistic shadow on the dial face, as lack of shadow can indicate flatness/fusion.
